observations: A large dark-gray ovoid head fills the left two-thirds of the teal field; yellow coiled loops crowd its left edge and a dense yellow-orange wave runs across the top.
The right eye socket holds a sunflower-like form—orange petals radiating from a dark center—while the left socket contains a tightly wound spiral in black and brown.
White scribble lines cross the gray head mass in loose arcs; a horizontal red slash and a serrated dark band mark the brow, and a small red-outlined rectangle sits near the lower jaw.
reading: Two mismatched eye forms—one radiating outward, one winding inward—give the head an off-balance, watchful feeling. The teal field stays open while the head absorbs layer after layer of line, making the figure feel dense and pressured against its calm background. The serrated brow and the small boxed shape near the jaw read as contained agitation rather than open expression.
contextAngle: Within the owned nifty-faces subset, title neighbors #97 and #99 use flat purple and flat yellow grounds. The teal ground here also appears in nnotb #197 from a different owned series—a color link the collector connects to nnxyz's broader visual range.

connections.reason: Both works share the same teal ground and use yellow looping lines as a recurring mark, offering a direct color and line comparison across two different owned series.

lookingQuestion: What does the difference between the two eye forms—one radiating outward, one winding inward—do to how you read the head as a whole?
ambiguities: The small red-outlined rectangle near the lower jaw is unclear in function—it may be a mouth element or a separate mark layer.
